He previously played for the [[Texas Longhorns men's basketball|Texas Longhorns]] and [[Cincinnati Bearcats men's basketball|Cincinnati Bearcats]]. ==High school career== Mitchell originally attended [[Sickles High School]] in [[Citrus Park, Florida]] for his freshman and sophomore year, then transferred to [[Bishop McLaughlin Catholic High School]] in [[Spring Hill, Florida]] for his junior year before lastly transferring to [[Montverde Academy]] in [[Montverde, Florida]] prior to his senior year.{{cite web | url=https://www.buckeyextra.com/story/mens-basketball/2021/04/30/versatile-2022-wing-dillon-mitchell-earns-ohio-state-offer-emoni-bates/7408875002/ | title=After frustrating Emoni Bates, 2022 prospect Dillon Mitchell earns Ohio State offer }}{{cite web | url=https://www.dispatch.com/story/sports/2021/08/23/ohio-state-future-uncertain-dillon-mitchell-starts-senior-year/8246613002/ | title=Ohio State recruit Dillon Mitchell begins senior year at Montverde Academy }} He was selected to play in the [[2022 McDonald's All-American Boys Game]] and the [[Jordan Brand Classic]].{{cite web | url=https://longhornswire.usatoday.com/2022/03/30/texas-basketball-dillon-mitchell-arterio-morris-signees-all-american-game-highlights/ | title=WATCH: Texas basketball signees shine during McDonald's All-American Game | date=March 30, 2022 }} He was the MVP of the Jordan Brand Classic after leading all scorers with 18 points.{{cite web | url=https://sports.yahoo.com/texas-signee-dillon-mitchell-wins-190650404.html | title=Texas signee Dillon Mitchell wins Jordan Brand Classic MVP | date=April 16, 2022 }} ===Recruiting=== Mitchell was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the top players in the 2022 class, according to major recruiting services. On October 25, 2021, he committed to playing college basketball for [[Texas Longhorns men's basketball|Texas]] over offers from [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State]] and [[Tennessee Volunteers basketball|Tennessee]].{{cite web | url=https://www.hookem.com/story/sports/mens-basketball/2021/10/25/texas-basketball-chris-beard-lands-commitment-dillon-mitchell/8544511002/ | title=Texas coach Chris Beard lands 2022 commitment from five-star forward Dillon Mitchell }} {{College Athlete Recruit Start|40=no|collapse=no|year=2022}} {{College Athlete Recruit Entry | recruit = Dillon Mitchell | position = [[Small forward|SF]] | hometown = [[Tampa, Florida|Tampa, FL]] | highschool = [[Montverde Academy]] (FL) | feet = 6 | inches = 8 | weight = 200 | 40 = | commitdate = October 25, 2021 | scout stars = | rivals stars = 5 | 247 stars = 5 | espn stars = 5 | espn grade = 94 }} {{College Athlete Recruit End | 40 = | year = 2022 | rivals ref title = Texas 2022 Basketball Commitments | scout ref title = | espn ref title = 2022 Texas Longhorns Recruiting Class | rivals school = texas | scout s = | espn schoolid = 251 | 247 overall = 8 | rivals overall = 4 | espn overall = 4 | accessdate = November 13, 2022 | bball = yes }} ==College career== At Texas, Mitchell averaged 4.3 points and 3.9 rebounds per game as a freshman.{{cite news |title=Dillon Mitchell doubling up on success for Texas men's basketball |url=https://www.statesman.com/story/sports/college/longhorns/mens-basketball/2023/12/28/dillon-mitchell-texas-basketball-forward-double-scoring-rebounding-sophomore-longhorns/72032182007/ |access-date=July 6, 2024 |work=[[Austin American-Statesman]] |date=December 28, 2023}} As a sophomore, Mitchell averaged 9.5 points and 7.6 rebounds per game. Following the season he transferred to [[Cincinnati Bearcats men's basketball|Cincinnati]], choosing the Bearcats over [[Miami Hurricanes men's basketball|Miami]] and [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn]].{{cite news |last1=Gates |first1=Billy |title=Dillon Mitchell transfers to Cincinnati Bearcats after 2 years with Texas Longhorns |url=https://www.kxan.com/sports-general/horns-report/dillon-mitchell-transfers-to-cincinnati-bearcats-after-2-years-with-texas-longhorns/ |access-date=July 6, 2024 |work=KXAN |date=May 19, 2024}} During the [[2024–25 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2024-25 season]] at Cincinnati, Mitchell started in all 33 games he played, averaging 9.5 points, 6.7 rebounds, and 1.6 assists per game in 28.1 minutes a game. At the end of the season, Mitchell entered the transfer portal and signed with [[St. John's Red Storm men's basketball|St. Johns]].{{cite news |last1=Borzello |first1=Jeff |title=Sources: Dillon Mitchell latest to transfer to St. John's |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/44817494/cincinnati-transfer-dillon-mitchell-commits-st-johns |access-date=April 25, 2025 |work=[[ESPN]] |date=April 23, 2025}} He averaged 8.3 points, 7.0 rebounds, 3.0 assists and 1.3 steals per game for St. John's and was named to the All-[[Big East Conference|Big East]] Third Team,
